# ColorInput

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Every form a colour may be written as in a public authoring position .

The hex arm is deliberately `` `#${string}` `` rather than `string`: a bare `string` would absorb [`ColorToken`](color-token.md), and a typo like `'slate-80'` would compile and silently resolve to black instead of failing the build.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
type ColorInput = Color | ColorToken | HexColor
```
